messages:
Rebecca: Quick update — Alice Chen (Sr Product Ops) is moving to a part-time advising role effective 2025-11-01. We’re opening a backfill for Senior Product Operations Manager (IC+manager scope). Tom Nguyen will act as interim lead for product ops while we run the search. Hiring doc + recruiter brief: https://redwood.company/hiring/sr-product-ops. Please send referrals or internal candidates to #people-ops or DM me. :handshake:
Tom Nguyen: happy to take this on — will sync with product + PD about priorities next week. Ping me if you have urgent handoffs.
Priya: congrats Alice for the new role — thanks for the heads up. Is this backfill headcount approved already?
Rebecca: yes, it's an approved replacement in this quarter's plan. We prefer internal first but will run an open search if needed.
Jae: can you add me to the interview panel? happy to help with ops/process interview.
Marta: would like a 1:1 with Tom this week to go over roadmap transitions.
RecruiterBot: New job posted: Senior Product Operations Manager — https://careers.redwood.ai/jobs/1234 — hiring owner: Rebecca
Tom Nguyen: added Jae and Marta to the panel list. Will share interview kit + sample questions by EOD Fri.
Priya: timeline? when do we expect screens / onsites?
Rebecca: target: resume screens over next 2 weeks, phone + work sample the 3rd week, onsites in 4–6 weeks, offer by end of quarter. We can accelerate for strong internal candidates.
Evan: ETA on job scorecard? I’ll prep the panel rubric once we have it.
Rebecca: I'll drop the scorecard into this thread later today and tag the panel. Also Alice agreed to a 2-week overlap to support handoffs — invites incoming.
Alice Chen: thanks all — excited to stay involved as an advisor. I'll start transition notes today and add owner lists for ongoing projects. :tada:
Tom Nguyen: huge thanks Alice! will coordinate the transition and triage any in-flight items.
Priya: sending two referrals now (DMing resume + context).
Marta: noted — joining Tom's 1:1 on Thursday.
Rebecca: action items summary: (1) Rebecca — post scorecard + job brief, (2) Tom — interview kit & initial handoff plan, (3) Recruiter — schedule screens, (4) Alice — transition doc. I'll update the hiring tracker weekly and post status here.
Rebecca: thanks everyone — please reach out to me or Evan if you have questions or candidate suggestions. :thumbsup:
